title: Analytics signal stitching and SLO aggregation playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a playbook and implementation plan to reliably "signal-stitch" events across the analytics ingest pipeline, runtime request surface, and Console dashboards so tenant-level SLIs can be computed and aggregated with bounded cost and predictable accuracy. This ticket covers design decisions for identifiers, fingerprinting for high-cardinality dimensions, cross-system trace linking, sampling rules, SLO rollups, and the dashboard/query patterns that operators and product teams will use.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Observability and Analytics owners
Prototype connector that joins events by request_id and fallback fingerprints with >98% correct stitching in synthetic replay
Defined sampling and retention policy that reduces storage cost by >=40% for high-cardinality tenants while keeping SLO estimates within 2% error
New Console SLO dashboard mockup with tenant, region, and model rollups and drilldowns
Runbook entry describing alerting thresholds, common failure modes, and recovery steps
tasks: Draft signal-stitching design doc (identifiers, fallback fingerprint scheme, join strategy)
Implement lightweight fingerprint generator in runtime library (deterministic 64-bit hash) and add to outgoing telemetry headers
Prototype joiner in analytics ingestion (Beam job) to correlate runtime traces, ingestion events, and quota usage rows
Define adaptive sampling rules: always-keep errors and SLO-window edge requests; probabilistic sampling for noise; tenant-specific rate caps
Create SLO aggregation query patterns and pre-aggregated materialized views for 1m and 1h rollups
Design Console dashboard wireframe and API endpoints for SLO rollups
Add runbook & escalation playbook; link to PagerDuty and on-call runbooks
risks_and_tradeoffs: Stitching by request_id is ideal but some third-party integrations (legacy SDKs) don't propagate headers; fingerprint fallback increases false-positives at high request rates
Aggressive sampling reduces storage/cost but increases SLO estimate variance for small tenants; we'll use tenant-aware adaptive sampling to mitigate
Materialized rollups speed dashboard queries but add write amplification; must balance freshness (1m) vs cost
Adding telemetry headers increases request size minimally but requires SDK/upstream rollouts; rollout plan needed to avoid gaps
notes_and_decisions: Decision: Use request_id as primary correlation key; fallback to (client_ip_hash, timestamp_bucket, route_hash) fingerprint when request_id is missing
Decision: Implement deterministic 64-bit xxhash for fingerprints to avoid cross-language incompatibilities
Decision: Sample heuristics - 100% keep for 5xx and latency > p99, 10% for normal traffic, tenant overrides for top 100 tenants
Decision: Pre-aggregate per-tenant SLI counters in a separate namespace to allow fast rollups and independent retention
Rejected: Using full trace export for all requests due to egress and storage cost; instead rely on trace links for sampled traces
implementation_notes: Runtime lib patch: add telemetry header 'X-RW-Trace' with JSON-lite payload (request_id, fingerprint, sdk_version) — will gate behind feature flag
Analytics ingestion: Beam join uses event-time windowing of 30s with watermark 2m to balance late arrivals
DB schema: add 'sli_fingerprint' varchar(32) column to event table; ensure indexes for tenant_id + fingerprint
Dashboard API: expose /v1/tenants/{id}/slo?from=&to=&rollup=1m that reads from materialized views
Backfill plan: run replay job for 7 days prior to rollout to seed fingerprints for historical SLO baselines
